真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 26 页

Complete the summary using the list of words A–I. Write the correct letter A–I. 原选项完整保留；Q31–36。

原文第4段The World of Sugar is also a story of similarity and continuity in sugar cultivation. For example, imported labour has been used for much large-scale production. German beet fields employed Polish workers; Mexicans and many others, including Sicilians, were vital to US sugar production. Cane cutting, Bosma shows, remains a poorly paid and brutal business to this day in many places in the world. But as well as this, the book is about the continuity of the use of traditional methods on small farms. In the mid 20th-century, this type of sugar production dominated in South Asia and Latin America.

原文第5段This is also a history of capitalists and sugar dynasties, as well as corporations that in some cases have remained influential over very long periods. Great firms and great interests have had profound influence on the policies of states. In many places - not just the British Caribbean but Cuba and the Philippines too - a powerful sugar bourgeoisie played a major role in politics and their interests were consequently protected by trade barriers and subsidies. In the battle for control of the industry, it was inevitably the poor countries which came off worse. All this is explored by Bosma with wonderful subtlety and control.

B agricultural developments

D untrained workers
E small-scale cultivation
F outdated methods
G financial controls
H migrant workers
I powerful individuals and businesses

材料精读 · 内容与词句

这部分将糖业的连续性放在两个层面观察：劳动者的处境和传统生产方式延续，资本、企业与国家政策的关系也长期存在。书评由田间劳动转向政治经济，解释谁能够保护自己的利益，谁更容易承担代价。

原文第4段
The World of Sugar is also a story of similarity and continuity in sugar cultivation. For example, imported labour has been used for much large-scale production. German beet fields employed Polish workers; Mexicans and many others, including Sicilians, were vital to US sugar production. Cane cutting, Bosma shows, remains a poorly paid and brutal business to this day in many places in the world. But as well as this, the book is about the continuity of the use of traditional methods on small farms. In the mid 20th-century, this type of sugar production dominated in South Asia and Latin America.

德国甜菜业、美国糖业都使用跨境劳工，说明不同地区的规模生产有相似的劳动力来源。作者继而指出，在文中所说的许多地方，砍甘蔗仍是报酬低、劳动艰苦的工作。另一种连续性是小农传统方法的延续，20世纪中叶在南亚和拉丁美洲占重要地位。连续性既指劳动处境，也指生产形式，不能把两者缩成同一个现象。

原文第5段
This is also a history of capitalists and sugar dynasties, as well as corporations that in some cases have remained influential over very long periods. Great firms and great interests have had profound influence on the policies of states. In many places - not just the British Caribbean but Cuba and the Philippines too - a powerful sugar bourgeoisie played a major role in politics and their interests were consequently protected by trade barriers and subsidies. In the battle for control of the industry, it was inevitably the poor countries which came off worse. All this is explored by Bosma with wonderful subtlety and control.

镜头从工人和农户转到资本家、糖业家族与长期有影响力的公司。书评认为，强大的糖业利益集团参与政治，并通过贸易壁垒和补贴保护自身利益；争夺行业控制权时，较穷国家更容易处于不利地位。最后一句是书评作者对Bosma叙述细致程度的赞赏，与前面概括的经济历史内容属于不同层次。

词语与搭配
similarity and continuity

相似性与延续性

similarity比较不同地方或群体，continuity关注跨时间的持续；两词并列组织本段的观察角度。

a poorly paid and brutal business

一种报酬低且极为艰苦的营生

business在这里指谋生活动，brutal强调劳动处境严酷；不是泛指某家公司。

remained influential over very long periods

在很长时期内持续具有影响力

remain后接形容词，说明状态持续；over very long periods突出跨越时间的力量。

trade barriers and subsidies

贸易壁垒与补贴

两者都是影响市场的政策工具，但机制不同：前者限制外部竞争，后者提供支持；其具体后果需要结合行业和政策设计讨论。

came off worse

在竞争或冲突中处于更不利的结果

come off是表示结果的短语动词，worse说明相对劣势；这里指贫穷国家在行业权力争夺中的处境。

句子精读
In many places - not just the British Caribbean but Cuba and the Philippines too - a powerful sugar bourgeoisie played a major role in politics and their interests were consequently protected by trade barriers and subsidies.

在许多地方——不只是英属加勒比地区，也包括古巴和菲律宾——强大的糖业资产阶级在政治中发挥重要作用，因此其利益受到贸易壁垒和补贴的保护。

两处短横线夹出地区范围的补充说明。主干用and连接played...与their interests were protected...；their指糖业资产阶级，consequently明确表现书评所概括的因果关系。not just...but...too扩大适用地区，并不意味着世界所有地区都完全一样。

In the battle for control of the industry, it was inevitably the poor countries which came off worse.

在争夺行业控制权的斗争中，最终遭遇更不利处境的，必然是那些贫穷国家。

In the battle...交代竞争情境；it was...which...是强调结构，突出承受不利结果的poor countries。came off worse描述结果，inevitably带有书评作者强烈的判断色彩，精读时应将这种概括与中性的统计描述区分。

读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。
